name: date-fns-compat
description: date-fns-shaped API (addDays, format, isBefore, TZDate, ...) backed by @internationalized/date: same names and argument order as date-fns/@date-fns/tz, taking and returning plain Date (or TZDate), with DST-safe calendar arithmetic. Also exports toZoned/fromZoned for migrating call sites onto ZonedDateTime directly.
